articles.title: Trump immigrant purge could cut social security for Americans by $2,000 a year
articles.summary:
New report on economic cost of anti-immigration campaign projects 8.6% reduction in retirement payments by 2034

Elderly Americans can expect to lose an average of $2,152 in annual social security benefits each, a projected 8.6% reduction in their retirement payments, by 2034 and every year after as a direct consequence of the economic fallout from the Trump administration’s anti-immigration campaign, if that carries on, according to a new report shared exclusively with the Guardian.

Already, US food prices are up, housing permits to build new homes are down – and even native-born Americans are losing out on potential jobs after the sudden exodus of 1.2 million foreign-born workers over the last two years as a result of Donald Trump’s policies, the report finds.

articles.title: The Democrats taking the fight to Republican strongholds
articles.summary:
In Florida, Kansas, Iowa and Texas, Democratic candidates are outperforming the predictions, but both parties may struggle to consolidate gains

  • This was originally published in The Stakes 2026, a newsletter about the midterm elections. Sign up to get it in your inbox

The most valuable education I received for becoming a political editor was growing up in Florida. During the entirety of the 18 years I lived there, it was a purple state that voted for Barack Obama twice, and while I would not say my community was diverse, the spectrum of political ideology was vast. I had a close friend who kept a life-sized cutout of George W Bush in her bedroom, and another who helped organize Amnesty International fundraisers against landmines. When the state turned deeply Republican in 2016, and remained that way, I continued to harbor a suspicion that it wasn’t the whole story.

Even so, nothing could prepare me for the sheer surprise when Angie Nixon – the state legislator who joined the Democratic Socialists of America running against Alex Vindman, a centrist with national name recognition – won the Democratic primary for Senate in Florida. That shock has continued in the months after, as we see the Democratic gubernatorial candidate David Jolly running neck-and-neck with Republican Byron Donalds, who seemed like a shoo-in just weeks ago. And while Nixon is polling behind her Republican opponent, Ashley Moody, the race is much closer than anyone following Florida politics expected. So much so that the senior progressive senator Bernie Sanders has newly poured millions of dollars from his campaign funds into the state, and the popular congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez went to campaign with Nixon last month.

Here in Michigan, we know that Canada is not our enemy. We need to end this tariff war now.

Politická napětí eskalují v souvislosti s kontroverzními výroky Bílého domu ohledně zahraniční politiky a nadcházejícími midtermy, zatímco blížící se tropická bouře Isaias hrozí narušením infrastruktury na pobřeží Mexického zálivu.
archive.security_status_en: U.S. markets are facing a severe shock following a tech sector sell-off triggered by China's DeepSeek model and rising concerns over AI-driven inflationary pressures. Political tensions are escalating amid controversial White House foreign policy remarks and upcoming midterms, while approaching Tropical Storm Isaias threatens infrastructure disruptions along the Gulf Coast.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu s důrazem na rotaci kapitálu do bezpečnějších aktiv, přičemž investoři budou vstřebávat dopady technologického výprodeje.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued volatility is expected with an emphasis on capital rotation into safer assets as investors absorb the impacts of the tech sell-off.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy čelí kombinaci prudkého výprodeje v technologickém sektoru vyvolaného obavami z konkurence v oblasti AI (DeepSeek) a rostoucím výnosům státních dluhopisů. Domácí bezpečnostní složky mezitím úspěšně zmařily teroristický útok inspirovaný ISIS v Minnesotě, zatímco blížící se hurikán Isaias ohrožuje pobřeží Mexického zálivu a vyvolává obavy o energetickou infrastrukturu.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is facing a combination of a sharp tech sector sell-off sparked by AI competition fears (DeepSeek) and rising Treasury yields. Meanwhile, domestic security agencies successfully thwarted an ISIS-inspired terrorist attack in Minnesota, as approaching Hurricane Isaias threatens the Gulf Coast and raises energy infrastructure concerns.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou volatilitu a nervozitu na trzích, přičemž investoři budou nadále přehodnocovat ocenění AI sektoru a sledovat vývoj kolem hurikánu Isaias.
archive.forecast_en: Increased volatility and market nervousness are expected in the coming days as investors continue to reassess AI sector valuations and monitor developments around Hurricane Isaias.

archive.security_status_cs: Americké trhy a politickou scénu výrazně rozbouřil propad v sektoru umělé inteligence vyvolaný obavami z konkurenčních modelů a slabších výnosů, doplněný o blížící se hurikán Isaias ohrožující Gulf Coast. Vnitropolitické napětí navíc eskaluje kvůli ostrým debatám před listopadovými midterms volbami, incidentům s ICE v New Yorku a přetrvávajícím geopolitickým rizikům na Blízkém východě.
archive.security_status_en: US markets and the political scene were sharply shaken by an AI sector rout driven by concerns over competing models and soft revenue reports, compounded by Hurricane Isaias threatening the Gulf Coast. Domestic political tension is also escalating due to fierce debates ahead of the November midterms, ICE incidents in New York, and lingering geopolitical risks in the Middle East.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na technologických trzích, zvýšenou opatrnost investorů kvůli politické polarizaci před midterms a sledování škod způsobených hurikánem Isaias.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in technology markets, heightened investor caution due to political polarization ahead of the midterms, and monitoring of damage caused by Hurricane Isaias are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy čelí silnému tlaku v důsledku propadu technologických trhů způsobeného čínským modelem DeepSeek a rostoucí politické nestability před nadcházejícími volbami do Kongresu. archive.security_status_en: The United States is facing severe pressure following a tech market rout triggered by China's DeepSeek model and mounting political instability ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Domestic tension is further heightened by ICE enforcement incidents in New York City and the approaching Hurricane Isaias threatening the Gulf Coast.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající tlak na technologické akcie, zvýšený zájem o bezpečné investice (safe havens) a sledování dopadů hurikánu Isaias na energetickou infrastrukturu v zálivu.
archive.forecast_en: Persistent downward pressure on tech stocks, heightened demand for safe-haven assets, and monitoring of Hurricane Isaias's impact on Gulf energy infrastructure are expected in the coming days.
